description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended trastuzumab deruxtecan for use within the Cancer Drugs Fund as a treatment option for treating HER2-positive unresectable or metastatic breast cancer in adults after 1 or more anti-HER2-based regimens. It is recommended only if the conditions in the managed access agreement are followed.
